title: Count authorized supplier purchase exposure by selected page grouping
description: A purchasing user chooses a finite grouping and sees current-page purchase-order counts. Development only. Reuse ERP-148 authorized bounded preview over ERP-031; keep all grouping to the current page, recheck current-user purchase-order menu and use existing HTTP operation audit. Preserve unknown settlement/receipt evidence, distinct currencies and ambiguous/unavailable links; never infer an accounts-payable balance or payment authority. Invalid modes and missing permission fail closed. No arbitrary SQL, migration, production SQL, real database execution, writes, secrets/.env change or deployment. Verify focused tests and safe Release build/test; no browser acceptance.
acceptance_criteria: Preview accepts only none/supplier/currency/linkStatus/receiptStatus group keys and rejects other values before source reads.
Counts derive only from the same authorized bounded page, keep ambiguous/unavailable and unknown receipt classes visible and never sum incompatible quantities or currencies.
Unit tests cover all group keys, empty/paged results, unknown statuses, denied users and no writes; document page-only count limits.
